summary: Stop remaining listeners on the current target and further propagation.

semantics.same_target: remaining listeners on current target are skipped
semantics.propagation: also sets stop-propagation behavior for later targets

caveats: The immediate flag is stronger than stopPropagation and must be distinct in the event subsystem.

tests.name: skips later same-target listener
tests.input: const t=new EventTarget(); let a=[]; t.addEventListener('x',e=>{a.push(1);e.stopImmediatePropagation()}); t.addEventListener('x',()=>a.push(2)); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('x')); console.log(a.join(','));
